projects.name: HabboHotel

projects.learnt: Designing robust RESTful APIs, managing security middlewares, implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and content management with Strapi and TypeScript.

experience.title: Backend Developer
description: Led backend development using Java 20+ and Spring Boot, achieving a 40% optimization in bulk data processing and environment configuration.
Designed and implemented event-driven architectures using Kafka and RabbitMQ with a Hexagonal approach, ensuring efficient and resilient asynchronous communication.
Developed and maintained REST and SOAP APIs with concurrency handling, supporting over 10,000 weekly transactions via Hibernate and JPA.
Automated compliance with legal regulations (Resolution 2275) in record time, reducing development and deployment cycles by 30%.
Increased code coverage to 95% through E2E testing (Playwright) and SOAP contract validation, significantly improving system reliability.
Designed a hierarchical geolocation microservice that integrated Java and PHP systems, establishing the foundation for a unified authentication and JWT session management ecosystem.
